content.short: Run Legends is a move-to-earn fitness RPG on Sui where real-world physical activity controls all character combat.
content.description: Run Legends is a pioneering move-to-earn fitness RPG built natively on the high-performance Sui blockchain by Talofa Games. The game turns walking or running into a high-action cooperative battle experience, where your real-world movement directly controls your character's combat actions. Players collaborate with friends in real-time to defeat the Sappers, mysterious foes that feed on human energy, earning on-chain rewards and exclusive digital assets truly owned by the user. By leveraging Sui's sub-second finality, Run Legends provides a seamless and responsive gaming experience.
content.meta: Run Legends offers move-to-earn fitness gaming and cooperative multiplayer combat on Sui. Discover Run Legends and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
